reason: the vault release was built with toolchain go1.26.10 and the service with go1.26.11, a patch release; the verifier's source is the same. Of go1.26.11's changes, the verifier's dependency closure reaches: the crypto/fips140 compliance changes (self-tests when generating or importing private keys, the FIPS service indicators of HKDF-Expand and of legacy Keccak in crypto/sha3, an OAEP check in FIPS 140-only mode), net's Dialer.Dial* address handling (the verifier dials nothing), a runtime revert on 32-bit platforms only, and compiler fixes. The verifier's compiled code under the two toolchains (amd64 and arm64, the vault's build flags) is identical except in those source-changed functions, none of which is on the verification path. net/http, crypto/tls and the cgo build fixes are outside it. Listed with vettid/service-vault#196 (GO-2026-6859)
